aggressive_definition_excerpt: No association was found between serum zinc levels and prostate cancer either overall or by tumor stage/grade.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The analysis included 392 prostate cancer cases and 783 controls matched on age, race/ethnicity, date/time of blood draw and fasting status.
reason: This is a nested case-control analysis of incident prostate cancer. The abstract only states that results were examined by tumor stage/grade without explicitly defining an advanced, high-grade, aggressive, metastatic, high-risk, or lethal stratum. The total analytic N is left null because the abstract reports separate case and control counts rather than an explicit total, and N must not be inferred by addition.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: No association was found between serum zinc levels and prostate cancer either overall or by tumor stage/grade.
estimate_classifications.reason: The existing full-text estimate is identified as overall incident prostate cancer; the abstract independently supports the overall endpoint, although it does not report this estimate's numeric values.
